question: Can an autoregressive TIGER backbone jointly predict recommendation SIDs and creative cues under a matched input/training protocol?
scope: Our TIGER-based controlled adaptations, not a claim about native TIGER's original output vocabulary or its published performance

arms.sid: TIGER-HCue: history SID+catalog cues -> next SID; catalog cues retrieved only for audio rendering
arms.joint: TIGER-HCue-Joint: identical history -> next SID followed by eight learned cue tokens

existing_native_tiger: Retain existing20k native SID-history TIGER+catalog-cue renderer as a separate external reference. It is not substituted for the newly matched control.

training.initialization: from scratch; same expanded SID+cue vocabulary, full parameter shapes and seeded initial parameter fingerprint for both arms
training.sampling: independent CPU RNG; same row+offset draws per update; rolling case digest checked after training
training.optimizer: Adafactor, no relative/scale LR, gradient clip1
training.loss: mean four-SID cross entropy +0.1 mean eight-cue cross entropy (joint only) +0.1 EOS cross entropy
training.cue_weight_source: fixed existing GenPlaylist cue weight; not tuned on test outcomes
training.test_selection: none; fixed final20k checkpoint, no best-test checkpoint selection
training.resume: model, Adafactor, sampler, torch/CUDA/dropout/python/numpy RNG and case digest
training.budget_interpretation: matched updates and sampled cases within TIGER pair, not identical FLOPs; report wall time and parameters; not budget-matched to diffusion5000+1000

inference.initial_context: 15 known items, each with frozen SID4 and catalog cue8
inference.rollout: five successive next-item calls; append selected item SID+catalog cues in both arms, never target or generated-cue oracle conditioning
inference.sid_search: beam20 ranked on exactly four legal SID tokens for both arms; no cue/EOS reranking
inference.joint_cues: after choosing SID, greedily generate eight tokens from full cue vocabulary; do not constrain cues to recommended song's catalog cues
inference.candidate_policy: complete dataset-specific catalog; visible history allowed; mask only previously emitted songs; five unique outputs
inference.cue_order: fixed SID->cue architectural baseline; no reverse-order experiment in this protocol

generation.models_prompts: reuse final Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and ACE revisions, adapter, prompts and decoding
generation.cohort: reuse exact two-dataset-fair-20261108 cohort; never select histories from observed scores
generation.pilot: one sample per new arm; validate SID/cue source, frozen history, hashes, seed and waveform before disjoint8-history shards

analysis.statistics: paired user/history bootstrap10000 seed42; follow-up contrast family reported separately from original two primary tests
analysis.interpretation: Joint output itself is not exclusive to diffusion. Test whether GenPlaylist adds value in recommendation/cue/audio trade-off; report improvements or regressions without selecting favorable seeds or outcomes.

execution.resource_policy: append finite tasks only after fresh reservation and actual worker checks; use actual existing deadline; do not interrupt existing work or start duplicate GPU worker
execution.paper: no manuscript change until verified results
